final_message:
Configured lab DNS on pc1 for all 17 requested hostnames and added MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`. All PCs and routers now use the lab DNS server; the existing connections and routes remain in place.

I checked the records against the PCs’ configured addresses and validated the startup scripts’ shell syntax. I couldn’t test live DNS queries because the environment does not provide access to Docker or BIND’s validation tools. The setup requires `named` to be available in the `kathara/base` image.
